name: Expressing Gratitude
equipment: A notebook and a partner (or mirror) to practice speaking aloud
instructions: This lesson focuses on expressing gratitude — practice these key phrases out loud:
I really appreciate you taking the time.
Thank you so much, that means a lot.
I couldn't have done it without your help.
I owe you one for this!
Try using at least three of these phrases in a short role-play conversation with a partner (or out loud to yourself).
